title: Hurry Up Whiskey, acoustic hook to camera
body:
playing this one the way it was written. [BEN: one true line about a night this song came from, or just leave it]

out now. acoustic version too if that's more your speed.

script.visual: tailgate, golden hour, guitar in lap, straight to camera
hold the shot, sing the hook of the chorus
script.line: the catchiest line of the chorus, real voice, no track behind it

script.visual: let the last note ring, small nod

shot_list: verse into chorus of Hurry Up Whiskey, ONE take, straight to camera, tailgate at golden hour
phone is fine. raw beats polished here
media_notes: Ben films the one-take hook (see shot list). Text card is the placeholder until then. Optional: fill the [BEN] line for a stronger caption.
notes: Caption has a [BEN] blank for a real detail. Fine to post without it too.
